body:
Steady Hands in the Land of Diclazepam
Brief background on my use without sounding snoody: done most recreational pharms particularly stimulants benzos and opiates, am currently prescribed suboxone and have tried and tripped on most common substances and several uncommon ones. My favorite benzo is Clonazolam but this diclazepam was great.
Took it at about 10:00am at my girlfriend's place. 4-5mg down the hatch. Took my daily suboxone dose as well of 1mg. Was talking with her family as they began to pack for home. For about an hour or so I felt a bit floaty nothing super perceptible, and my conversation skills and balance was lucid as if I were sober. About 2 hours later I'm really feeling it and my god is it lovely.
I feel as if I can do anything in the world without a care in my mind. There is no stress, and my body is very relaxed much like Valium... It did strike up a small bout of nausea on the peak but that could have been unrelated.
For the peak I sit in a recliner and chat away until her family departs. The car is packed as I help carry our new furniture out the door to head to Pittsburgh with my gfs family and then I return to my girl and we gear up to drive to NY. I recall having a hard time (3 hours in) coming up with specific words for things I was trying to say or describe at some points. Memory impairment was very prevalant.
I felt more or less stress free and gently lifted for the remainder of the day. In the evening I take 300mg gabapentin and drift off peacefully.
I wake up still feeling very good and with no hangover or withdrawal.
